text:
The Crocodile vs The Crab Colony vs Giant Squid!!

Used Seedance 2 extension.

Seedance 2 prompt-

Nightmare island coastline. Black volcanic sand, jagged rock formations, crashing waves, thick storm clouds overhead. The beach feels abandoned and prehistoric. Hyper-real creature-feature action. Aggressive handheld camera, rapid cut-tos, speed ramps, low-angle tracking shots, crash zooms. Sound: crashing surf, crocodile roars, clicking crab claws, sand eruptions, frantic breathing.

⸻

0–2s — HOOK

Low-angle tracking shot.

A survivor is already sprinting across a black sand beach.

Completely exhausted.

Behind him—

A gigantic mega crocodile explodes from a tidal pool.

Forty feet long.

Covered in scars.

Its massive body bulldozes through driftwood and rocks.

The beach shakes beneath every step.

⸻

2–5s — ESCALATION

Side tracking shot.

The survivor runs flat out.

The crocodile gains rapidly.

Its jaws snap shut inches behind him.

Sand erupts everywhere.

The survivor glances ahead.

The beach is covered with thousands of strange dark boulders.

No time to think.

He runs directly into them.

⸻

5–8s — REVEAL

Wide shot.

The “boulders” start moving.

One.

Ten.

Hundreds.

Thousands.

The entire beach comes alive.

Gigantic armored crabs emerge from beneath the sand.

Some as large as motorcycles.

Massive claws.

Thick black shells.

The survivor weaves through them.

The crocodile crashes straight into the colony.

⸻

8–11s — CHAOS

The crab swarm attacks instantly.

Hundreds of claws snap at the crocodile.

The crocodile retaliates violently.

Crushing crabs.

Throwing them aside.

Tearing through the colony.

The beach becomes complete chaos.

Shells flying.

Sand clouds everywhere.

The survivor keeps running.

⸻

11–13s — THE TWIST

The fighting suddenly stops.

The sand beneath the battlefield begins vibrating.

A deep rumble.

Everything freezes.

Even the crocodile.

Then—

The beach erupts.

⸻

13–15s — SHOCKING PAYOFF

A colossal alpha crab bursts from beneath the sand.

The size of a truck.

One claw larger than a car.

Before the crocodile can react—

The giant claw snaps around its neck.

Lifts the crocodile completely off the ground.

The survivor turns and watches in disbelief.

Then a second giant claw emerges from beneath the sand behind him.

———

Seedance 2 extension prompt - 

The giant crab fights back fiercely as the smaller crabs swarm the crocodile. The crocodile, powerful and aggressive, slams the massive crab into the sand while swatting the smaller ones away, sending them flying through the air. The giant crab charges again. Both creatures leap at each other and collide violently mid-air.

Suddenly, a massive tentacle erupts from the sea. A colossal giant squid rises from the depths, its enormous arms lashing out. It seizes both the crab and the crocodile, hurls them into the sky, and devours them whole. Watching in horror, the person turns and sprints into a nearby cave.
content: Nightmare island coastline. Black volcanic sand, jagged rock formations, crashing waves, thick storm clouds overhead. The beach feels abandoned and prehistoric. Hyper-real creature-feature action. Aggressive handheld camera, rapid cut-tos, speed ramps, low-angle tracking shots, crash zooms. Sound: crashing surf, crocodile roars, clicking crab claws, sand eruptions, frantic breathing.

translations.es:
---
Costa de la isla de pesadilla. Arena volcánica negra, formaciones rocosas irregulares, olas rompiendo, gruesas nubes de tormenta sobre la cabeza. La playa se siente abandonada y prehistórica. Acción de criaturas hiperrealista. Cámara en mano agresiva, cortes rápidos, rampas de velocidad, tomas de seguimiento en ángulo bajo, zooms de choque. Sonido: oleaje rompiendo, rugidos de cocodrilo, chasquidos de pinzas de cangrejo, erupciones de arena, respiración frenética.
translations.fr:
---
Littoral de l'île cauchemardesque. Sable volcanique noir, formations rocheuses déchiquetées, vagues déferlantes, épais nuages d'orage au-dessus. La plage semble abandonnée et préhistorique. Action hyper-réaliste de créatures. Caméra à l'épaule agressive, coupes rapides, accélérations, plans en contre-plongée, zooms brusques. Son : vagues déferlantes, rugissements de crocodiles, cliquetis de pinces de crabes, éruptions de sable, respiration frénétique.
---
translations.ja:
---
ナイトメアアイランドの海岸線。黒い火山砂、ギザギザの岩の形成、打ち寄せる波、頭上に厚い嵐の雲。ビーチは放棄され、先史時代のように感じられる。ハイパーリアルなクリーチャーフィーチャーアクション。アグレッシブなハンドヘルドカメラ、急速なカット、スピードランプ、ローアングルトラッキングショット、クラッシュズーム。音：打ち寄せる波、ワニの咆哮、カニの爪のカチカチ音、砂の噴出、慌ただしい呼吸。
translations.ko:
---
악몽의 섬 해안선. 검은 화산 모래, 뾰족한 암석 지형, 부서지는 파도, 머리 위로 두꺼운 폭풍 구름. 해변은 버려지고 선사시대 같은 느낌을 준다. 하이퍼 리얼 크리처 피처 액션. 공격적인 핸드헬드 카메라, 빠른 컷 투, 스피드 램프, 로우 앵글 트래킹 샷, 크래시 줌. 소리: 부서지는 파도, 악어의 포효, 딸깍거리는 게 집게발, 모래 폭발, 거친 숨소리.
translations.pt-BR: Costa da ilha do pesadelo. Areia vulcânica preta, formações rochosas irregulares, ondas quebrando, nuvens de tempestade espessas no céu. A praia parece abandonada e pré-histórica. Ação hiper-real de criaturas. Câmera de mão agressiva, cortes rápidos, speed ramps, tomadas de rastreamento em ângulo baixo, crash zooms. Som: ondas quebrando, rugidos de crocodilo, estalos de garras de caranguejo, erupções de areia, respiração frenética.
translations.zh-CN:
---
梦魇岛海岸线。黑色火山沙，锯齿状岩石结构，拍打的海浪，头顶厚重的风暴云。海滩感觉被遗弃且史前。超现实生物特写动作。激进的手持摄像机，快速切换，速度变化，低角度跟踪镜头，快速变焦。声音：拍打的海浪，鳄鱼的咆哮，蟹爪的咔嗒声，沙子的爆裂声，急促的呼吸。
